title: mymind header
description: A fixed header that starts as a wide transparent bar (wordmark, three dot-marked links in the middle, a dotted sign-in link and a tangerine pill) and, over the first 120px of scrolling, gathers into a narrower floating white pill with a soft shadow. On phones it is always the white pill, with a round menu button that opens a dropdown card.
notes: fixed: it overlays the top of the next block (the hero leaves room for it)
bar-to-pill morph is a CSS scroll timeline (desktop); browsers without it show the bar
needs JavaScript only for the phone menu
